_about: The games shown in Kids mode > Games. Add a game by adding an entry. status: live or coming-soon. playUrl is the Wix page that holds the game; embed is the game script and tag, used to open it inside Kids mode. Images can be full links or files next to this one.

games.title: The Word Play
games.description: Catch falling letters and spell words before the stack crosses the line.
games.about: A detective word game set to the 23 songs of The Word Play album. Letter blocks fall from the sky. Switch them while they fall, line them up, and spell words left to right to clear them. Each case lasts one song.
howToPlay: Pick a letter while the block falls. Vowels can be any of A, E, I, O, U.
Move, turn and drop the blocks so they spell a word in a row, left to right.
Keep the stack under the yellow tape until the song ends to close the case.
goodToKnow: Easy, Medium and Hard modes. The tape sits lower on harder modes.
Clues can show where a letter fits. Turn them off on the title screen.
23 cases, one for each song on the album.
Works on phones, tablets and classroom screens, with touch or a keyboard.

games.title: Clean Up Crew
games.description: Sort, stack and tidy up to the beat.
games.about: A tidy-up game set to the song Clean Up Crew (We Got This). Toys are all over the playroom. Drag each one into the right bin before the song ends, and watch the room go from messy to sparkling.
howToPlay: Press Play. The song starts, and the timer is the song.
Drag a toy into the bin with its picture: blocks, stuffies, books or clothes. Or tap a toy, then tap a bin.
Put every toy away before the song ends to earn three stars.
goodToKnow: Little mess (10 toys) or Big mess (16 toys). Pick with Choose Level.
A wrong bin never costs anything: the toy just bounces back.
Classroom timer: a big-screen countdown for the whole class, with a class streak.
Bins use pictures, not words, so pre-readers can play. Grown-ups can turn sounds and toy counts on or off.

games.title: Scrub Squad
games.description: Scrub every germ off both hands before the song ends.
games.about: A handwashing game set to the song No Germs. Sneaky germs creep onto two big cartoon hands, palm side and back. Rub them off zone by zone while the song plays: palms, fingers, fingertips, thumbs and wrists.
howToPlay: Press Let’s scrub! The song starts, and the song is the clock.
Rub back and forth on a germ with a finger or the mouse. Taps don’t scrub: it takes real rubbing.
Fill every bubble at the bottom. Leave a spot half done and the sneaky germs tiptoe back!
goodToKnow: Every zone needs its full scrub time, like real handwashing: about 20 seconds in all.
Standard (ages 5–8) has 10 zones. Littles (ages 3–5) has 6 bigger zones and bigger germs.
Four skin tones to pick from. No scores and no losing: the song keeps going until every zone is clean.
Works on phones, tablets, Chromebooks and classroom screens, in landscape or portrait.
